fullContent:
Kulathadi Kashayam 
 Reference: Yogagrantha 
 Introduction 
 Kulathadi Kashayam is herbal Ayurvedic medicine which is useful in treatment of menstrual problem in women in cases of secondary amenorrhea and cryptomenorrhea, period irregularity. Kulathadi Kashayam is also helpful in detoxifying body and improving digestion. It pacifies aggravated Vata and Kapha, but aggravates pitta. 
 Ingredients 
 Herbal decoction is prepared from 10 grams of each of:- 
 
 Kulatha / Horse gram (Dolichos biflorus) 
 Garlic (Alium cepa) 
 Eranda / Castor (Ricinus communis) 
 Til – Sesame seed (Sesamum indicum) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Herbal ingredients (coarse powder) 1 part boiled in 16 parts of water and reduced to 4 parts. 
 Dosage 
 5 – 10 ml, before meals, or on empty stomach, once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Irregular menstruation 
 Amenorrhea 
 Poly cystic ovarian syndrome. 
 
 Contraindications 
 Its high dose may lead to excessive menstrual bleeding. It should be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
